shots.description: Hero shot: over-the-shoulder third-person view of the player on the coast avenue at golden hour, palms and the marina behind, the living title city in the same world the player walks into.
Driving a coupe at true dusk (day cycle ~0.96): lit building windows, street lamps on, speed on the HUD.
Police chase at four wanted stars: white C.V.P.D. cruisers with red-and-blue light bars converging on the player's car, bust meter on the HUD.
An active timed story job: the gold objective pillar and ring mark the destination, with the mission banner and countdown on the HUD.
